verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a first-party GrowthBook Proxy that runs next to your app, caches SDK payloads and keeps serving flags if the API is down. It also adds streaming updates, and the full platform can be self-hosted. Missing for 10: proxy deployment and configuration detail, explicit documentation that SDK traffic stays within your network, and independent or hands-on corroboration of proxy failover.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network

citations.quote: Run the GrowthBook Proxy next to your app to cache SDK payloads, reduce latency, and keep serving flags if the API is down.
It turbocharges your GrowthBook implementation by providing speed, scalability, security, and real-time feature rollouts.
Streaming - Updates your application in real-time as features are changed or toggled in GrowthBook (JavaScript and React only)
Run GrowthBook on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, including MongoDB, the API, and the front-end.
